instruction: Remove Chrome from your favorites dock while keeping the other applications.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Chrome from favorites while keeping Thunderbird and Vim. Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric to verify the result contains only Thunderbird and Vim.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the complete instruction requirement: Chrome removed from favorites while Thunderbird and Vim are kept
Result getter (get_vm_command_line) correctly executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps' to retrieve current GNOME dock favorites
Expected getter (get_rule) correctly returns the rules dict containing expected apps list
Metric function (check_gnome_favorite_apps) correctly parses the gsettings output string using eval(), checks length equality, and uses set comparison for order-independent matching

Expected values ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop'] are semantically correct - exactly what should remain after removing Chrome from initial list ['thunderbird.desktop', 'vim.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']
No postconfig needed beyond existing sleep - gsettings persists state independently of UI and is always accessible
No state timing issues - gsettings backend doesn't require UI to be open
Logic handles the requirement completely: both removal of Chrome AND preservation of other apps verified through exact list matching
